idea-plugin.name: Architecture Breadcrumbs
idea-plugin.description:
Stop Losing Architecture Decisions — Embed Them in Your Code

Architecture Breadcrumbs lets you embed architectural context directly in your codebase. Annotate decisions, patterns, constraints, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks using simple structured comments. Your reasoning stays with your code — versioned, searchable, and visible to every developer on the team.

Why Architecture Breadcrumbs?

Architectural knowledge degrades over time. Critical decisions end up in forgotten wiki pages, buried Slack threads, or the minds of people who have moved on. Architecture Breadcrumbs keeps that knowledge where it belongs — right next to the code it describes.

Breadcrumb Categories

  • Decision — Why a specific approach was chosen
  • Pattern — Which design patterns are in use and why
  • Constraint — Hard limits from business, regulations, or infrastructure
  • Trade-off — What was sacrificed and what was gained
  • Assumption — Hidden assumptions that should stay visible
  • Risk — Known risks flagged for ongoing awareness

Annotations

Add breadcrumbs using structured comment annotations:

// @arch:pattern=Repository @arch:reason=Decouples domain from persistence
// @arch:layer=infrastructure @arch:link=ADR-042

Annotations are plain comments in your source files. They work with your existing version control workflow — no external files or sync tools required.

IDE Integration

  • Syntax highlighting with colored backgrounds for each category
  • Inlay hints showing breadcrumb details inline
  • Gutter icons for quick identification
  • Navigation between related breadcrumbs
  • Breadcrumbs Tool Window — browse by category or file
  • VCS-friendly storage via .arch-breadcrumbs.json

Pro Features

  • Unlimited breadcrumbs and layers
  • Architecture Map — visualize breadcrumbs across layers and modules
  • Auto-detection of common patterns and layer assignments
  • Layer consistency checks
  • Export to Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams
  • Cross-linking between breadcrumbs

Team Features

  • Team dashboard with breadcrumb coverage and trends
  • Team consistency checks across repositories

Pricing

Tier Price Highlights
Free $0 All 6 categories, up to 20 breadcrumbs, 3 custom layers, gutter icons, explorer
Pro $2.90/mo or $29/yr Unlimited breadcrumbs/layers, Architecture Map, auto-detection, export, cross-linking
Team $5.90/user/mo All Pro features + team dashboard + team consistency checks

Supported Languages

Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (build 243+)
  • Java 21+
  • Optional: Git4Idea plugin for VCS integration

Support

  • Documentation
  • Issue Tracker (GitHub)
  • Email Support: support@jakubjirak.com
  • Community Forum

What's New

  • 6 Breadcrumb Categories - Annotate code with Decision, Pattern, Constraint, Trade-off, Assumption, and Risk markers

  • Breadcrumb Explorer - Dedicated tool window to browse all annotations by category or file
